title: A Preference, Not Permission
summary: Use a session-bound CSRF token and Origin validation to protect a harmless preference change.
description: Compare vulnerable and fixed preference endpoints with direct synthetic HTTP requests; no real browser victim is involved.

services.name: integrity-review
services.purpose: Synthetic session, CSRF token, Origin, and harmless preference service

objectives.title: Measure the request-integrity gap
objectives.label: Compare cross-site-style requests at vulnerable and fixed endpoints

objectives.title: Prove layered request integrity
objectives.label: Validate session binding, CSRF token, Origin, and legitimate preference change

learningOutcomes: Explain why an ambient session cookie does not prove user intent
Validate a CSRF token bound to the active session
Use strict Origin validation as an additional request-integrity control
Prove remediation with rejected invalid requests and an accepted valid request
